meta_dir.description: Directory path for storing metadata files.

data_dir.description: Directory path for storing TSM data files.

reporting_enabled.description: Enable reporting of usage data to usage.influxdata.com.

http_bind_address.description: Host and port to bind the HTTP API service to.

http_enabled.description: Enable or disable the HTTP API service.

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the HTTP API. Requires `https_cert_file` and `https_key_file`.

https_cert_file.description: Path to the certificate file for HTTPS (PEM format).

https_key_file.description: Path to the private key file for HTTPS (PEM format).

log_path.description: Path to the access log file. If empty, logs go to stderr.

logging_level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn, or error.

monitoring_enabled.description: Enable internal monitoring endpoint (deprecated in newer versions).

retention_check_interval.description: How often to check and enforce retention policies.

shard_precreation_check_interval.description: How often to check for shards needing precreation.

shard_precreation_advance_period.description: How far ahead to precreate shards (must be ≥ shard-duration).
